profile_and_lore.background_biography: South Korean actor born in Busan and educated at Seoul Institute of the Arts. He made his acting debut in 2021 and gained wider recognition through Night Has Come and Study Group.

South Korean actor and model who began his entertainment career as a model before moving into acting. He gained major international recognition through Lovely Runner and has continued expanding his leading-man roles.

South Korean actor known for emotionally demanding roles across television and film. He rose to prominence through Hotel del Luna, 18 Again, Youth of May, The Glory and Sweet Home before making his major film debut in Exhuma.

South Korean actress and singer who began her entertainment career as a member of I.O.I and later gugudan before developing a career in acting. She is known for roles in Hotel Del Luna, Moonshine, Cafe Minamdang and Welcome to Samdal-ri.
South Korean actress known for roles in School 2021 and All of Us Are Dead, where her performance as Choi Nam-ra brought her international recognition.
South Korean actress and model who gained attention through Law School before establishing herself through Alchemy of Souls, Moving and Resident Playbook.

South Korean actress born in Seoul in 2002. She signed with BH Entertainment in 2024 and began her on-screen acting career in 2025, appearing in projects including Kick Kick Kick Kick, Melo Movie and Crushology 101.

South Korean actress who gained recognition through The Heirs and Descendants of the Sun before becoming a leading actress through Fight for My Way, Arthdal Chronicles, My Liberation Notes and Queen of Tears.
South Korean actress known for leading roles in Spring Waltz, Shining Inheritance, Dong Yi and W. She has also received major recognition for film performances including Cold Eyes.
South Korean actress who debuted in the 2016 film Vanishing Time: A Boy Who Returned and later appeared in works including Twinkling Watermelon, Light Shop and other film and television projects.

related_works_credits: Vanishing Time: A Boy Who Returned (2016)

profile_and_lore.background_biography: South Korean singer-songwriter and actress whose career began with her music debut in 2008. She became one of Korea's most prominent solo artists while also establishing herself as an acclaimed actress through projects such as My Mister, Hotel del Luna, Broker and When Life Gives You Tangerines.
South Korean actress who rose to prominence through Scandal Makers and later became known for films and dramas including A Werewolf Boy, Oh My Ghost, Strong Girl Bong-soon and Daily Dose of Sunshine.
South Korean actress known for Mental Coach Jegal and Buried Hearts. Her more recent work includes Filing for Love, expanding her profile in Korean television.

South Korean actress, singer and former member of Miss A. She transitioned from idol activities into a successful acting career, becoming known for roles in Dream High, While You Were Sleeping, Vagabond, Start-Up and Anna.
South Korean actress who gained widespread recognition through Extraordinary You and later became internationally known for her leading performance in Lovely Runner.
South Korean actress born in Busan in 2000. She studied film at Sangmyung University and has appeared in Korean screen productions including the Netflix series Karma.
A character from The Shiunji Family Children.

profile_and_lore.character_motivation: To become the strongest duelist and dominate every opponent.
profile_and_lore.background_biography: Zarc is the central antagonist of Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V and the original incarnation of Yuya Sakaki, Yuto, Yugo and Yuri. His soul was divided into four counterparts after his defeat by Ray Akaba.
A quiet and intelligent student from Classroom of the Elite known for her love of books and calm personality.

profile_and_lore.personality_archetype: Sweet, caring, athletic, cool under pressure.
profile_and_lore.background_biography: The female protagonist of Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie. She is known for being cute and affectionate while also having an unexpectedly cool and protective side.
The protagonist of Himouto! Umaru-chan. At school she appears as a perfect student, while at home she transforms into a lazy, gaming-loving chibi version of herself.
The third Nakano quintuplet. Miku is quiet and reserved and has a strong interest in Japanese history, particularly historical warlords.
The fifth Nakano quintuplet. Itsuki is serious and responsible and initially struggles academically despite her strong desire to become a teacher like her late mother.

profile_and_lore.character_motivation: To make people smile through entertaining Action Duels while becoming a great duelist like his father.
profile_and_lore.background_biography: The protagonist of Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V and the Standard Dimension counterpart of Zarc.

profile_and_lore.character_motivation: To protect the Xyz Dimension and rescue Ruri Kurosaki.
profile_and_lore.background_biography: The Xyz Dimension counterpart of Yuya Sakaki and one of Zarc's four reincarnated counterparts.

profile_and_lore.character_motivation: To find Rin and protect his friends.
profile_and_lore.background_biography: The Synchro Dimension counterpart of Yuya Sakaki and one of Zarc's four reincarnated counterparts.
The Fusion Dimension counterpart of Yuya Sakaki and one of Zarc's four reincarnated counterparts.
Yuya Sakaki's childhood friend and one of the four girls connected to the dimensional counterparts of Zarc and Ray.
The Fusion Dimension counterpart of Yuzu Hiiragi and one of the four girls connected to the dimensional lore of Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V.
The Xyz Dimension counterpart of Yuzu Hiiragi and the younger sister of Shun Kurosaki. Yuto seeks to rescue her after she is taken to the Fusion Dimension.
The Synchro Dimension counterpart of Yuzu Hiiragi and Yugo's childhood friend.

profile_and_lore.character_motivation: To stop Zarc and protect the world from his destructive power.
profile_and_lore.background_biography: A central figure in the original dimension's history and the counterpart origin behind the four girls Yuzu, Serena, Ruri and Rin. Ray played a decisive role in defeating Zarc.
Chinese actor and model best known internationally for his leading role as Gu Wei in Put Your Head on My Shoulder. He has continued to build a career in modern romance and youth dramas.

related_works_credits: Put Your Head on My Shoulder (2019)

profile_and_lore.background_biography: Chinese actor and singer who gained widespread attention through youth and romance dramas including When I Fly Towards You and You Are Desire.
Chinese actor who rose to prominence through historical and romantic dramas. He gained major attention through My Journey to You and Story of Kunning Palace.
Chinese actor and model known for his work in youth, romance and historical dramas. He gained international popularity through Find Yourself and the family drama Go Ahead.

Chinese actor and singer widely known internationally as Miles Wei. He has become particularly recognized for mature romantic roles in dramas such as Perfect and Casual, Unforgettable Love and Hello, I'm At Your Service.
Chinese actress who has gained attention through youth and historical dramas, including The Legend of Shen Li, The Double and The Best Thing.

Chinese actress and model known for performances in romantic and historical dramas. She gained significant attention through My Journey to You and later starred in projects such as Love Me, Love My Voice and Moonlit Reunion.

Chinese actress known for her lively performances in youth, romance and historical dramas. She gained major popularity through New Life Begins and My Calorie Boy, and continued to rise with projects such as Romance on the Farm and Love of Nirvana.

related_works_credits: In the Name of the Brother (2024)
